 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The horizontal 5 divider separates the two halves. Select the marker
    # color whose count increases more from the upper half to the lower half.
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row)
    upper = grid[:divider]
    lower = grid[divider + 1:]
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)})
    deltas = {c: sum(row.count(c) for row in lower) - sum(row.count(c) for row in upper) for c in colors}
    chosen = max(colors, key=lambda c: deltas[c])
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]

if __name__ == '__main__':
